# Update documentation for attribution markers

## Goal

Update all related documentation to reflect the new attribution markers and their consumption.

## Scope

- Update code comments in `log_parser.py` documenting the new fields (`source`, `actor`, `reason`).
- Update the proxy-usage-analysis skill README with information about attribution consumption.
- Update `analyze_mode_flips.py` docstring to document the new deterministic classification.
- Update any relevant docs site entries.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant docs site entries.
- [ ] `log_parser.py` docstring and module-level doc updated with attribution field descriptions.
- [ ] proxy-usage-analysis skill README documents the attribution consumption feature.
- [ ] `analyze_mode_flips.py` docstring documents the `source`-based classification.
- [ ] All code comments reference the parent work item LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH.

## Key Files

- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/log_parser.py`
- `.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/README.md`
- `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py`
- `docs/` (relevant entries)

## Dependencies

- None (can be done alongside implementation tasks; final polish after the implementation children land)
